summary: You take ILAC 130 and 131, a WIM gateway course and the ILAC 277 capstone, each for at least 4 units, and electives to reach 60 units: ILAC courses at the 100 or 200 level and up to three second-year or higher Spanish language courses, all letter graded. BOSP courses (up to 15 units) and pre-approved outside courses (up to 5 units) are moved in by hand. The OPI, completing all work in Spanish, and honors are checked by hand.
